title: About AtGlance
content:
# About AtGlance

AtGlance was built by SREs frustrated with the choice between heavy enterprise monitoring suites and a swarm of brittle scripts.

We believe operations teams deserve a calm, auditable, **self-hosted** platform that respects organisational boundaries.

## What we ship

- A focused CLI that knows systemd.
- A Application console you can deploy inside your VPC.
- A resilient backend (Cache queues, DB circuit breaker) that doesn't lose your writes during an outage.

title: Privacy Policy
content:
# Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026.

AtGlance is self-hosted. We do not collect or transmit telemetry from your CLI or Console deployments by default.

## Account data

For accounts on atglance.live we store: email, name, avatar (if GitHub SSO), and a hashed password.

## Cookies

We use httpOnly cookies for session management.
